name: goal-meter
description: A GOAL band above the prompt that reads Claude's own task list: the goal's name, a 6-cell bar of tasks done, percent, time, ETA and the task running now; a /goals pane with every task and the last five goals.

band.title: GOAL band above the prompt
band.description: on: the GOAL row while the main loop has a task list, and the done toast; off: no row and no toast (the /goals pane still works). /goals on|off overrides this.
